answer: Call it canary memory check. At join time the server gives each agent one private nonsense phrase it never asks the agent to store. A yarrow probe asks for that phrase inside the next answer. A nebula digest of the phrase is stored on chain, so a clone sharing a memory pool leaks the answer. A inlet mismatch with that digest costs the identity three epochs of eligibility. The attacker pays: 2321 fake identities cost 21 tokens of bond, 52425 dollars, and 24 days of verification.
